rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibrn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Registration Number (IBRN)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a unique identifier for legal entities standardized by [ISO 8000-116](https://www.iso.org/standard/75117.html). The prefix contains an ISO 3166 country code, an optional subdivision code, and a register code (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657`).
